# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_tax_code.py — do not edit manually
# The legislated tax code's per-instrument and per-good effects. Schema and rules:
# docs/systems/tax_code_schema.md. All country scope.
#
# te_tax_gen_init_*: called by te_tax_init_country (te_tax_state_effects.txt). Each write
# happens only if the variable is absent, so an existing value is never overwritten.
# te_tax_gen_sync_*: called by te_tax_sync_collection (te_tax_collection_effects.txt),
# the only writer of a rule-on country's native tax state, which saves
# scope:te_tax_country and scope:te_tax_sponsor first. Each sync removes what the
# enacted code does not hold and adds what it holds and is missing. Amendment and
# goods changes are not visible later in the same effect, so run each at most once
# per effect execution; a call in a later execution then changes nothing. The
# removal loop never touches the enacted amendment, and the add checks only that one.
# te_tax_gen_count_goods_drift: the writer's drift count of goods (te_tax_detect_drift).
# The scheduler's parts follow the syncs: te_tax_gen_sunset_<key>,
# te_tax_gen_commence_<slot>, te_tax_gen_hold_missed_<slot>, te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>,
# te_tax_gen_store_<slot>, te_tax_gen_next_month and te_tax_gen_history_write, called
# by te_tax_schedule_effects.txt. The migration's parts follow:
# te_tax_gen_migrate_rates, te_tax_gen_migrate_goods and te_tax_gen_migrate_provisions,
# called by te_tax_migrate_country (te_tax_migration_effects.txt). The copies for new
# countries close the file: te_tax_gen_copy_code, te_tax_gen_copy_slot_<slot> and
# te_tax_gen_copy_enacted, called by te_tax_civil_war_effects.txt, with the policy
# obligations' te_tax_gen_copy_obligations and te_tax_gen_clear_obligations (plan Task 12).

# Wage tax: leaves exactly amendment_te_tax_wage_<te_tax_en_wage> on the
# carrier, and none at index 0.
te_tax_gen_sync_wage = {
	active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
		every_scope_amendment = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_amendment_is_wage = yes
				NOT = { te_tax_amendment_matches_wage = yes }
			}
			remove_amendment = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage = 1 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_wage_1 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_wage_1 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage = 2 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_wage_2 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_wage_2 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage = 3 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {

# Dividend tax: leaves exactly amendment_te_tax_div_<te_tax_en_div> on the
# carrier, and none at index 0.
te_tax_gen_sync_div = {
	active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
		every_scope_amendment = {
			limit = {
				te_tax_amendment_is_div = yes
				NOT = { te_tax_amendment_matches_div = yes }
			}
			remove_amendment = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_div = 1 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_div_1 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_div_1 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}

# carrier, and none at index 0.

			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 5 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_5 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_5 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 6 }
		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_6 } }
				add_amendment = { type = amendment_te_tax_cons_6 sponsor = scope:te_tax_sponsor cooldown = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {

		active_law:lawgroup_taxation = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_amendment = amendment_type:amendment_te_tax_cons_7 } }

	else_if = {

# Taxed goods: the native consumption-tax list holds a catalog good exactly when
# te_tax_en_g_<good> = 1, and never holds a good outside the catalog, so the native
# taxed set always equals the enacted one.
te_tax_gen_sync_goods = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } }
		add_taxed_goods = g:aeroplanes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes }
		remove_taxed_goods = g:aeroplanes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_g_automobiles = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } }
		add_taxed_goods = g:automobiles
	}
	else_if = {

		remove_taxed_goods = g:automobiles
	}

# Drift (te_tax_detect_drift, te_tax_collection_effects.txt): +1 to te_tax_drift_goods for
# each good whose native consumption tax differs from the enacted list, counted before
# the sync puts it back. Reads native state; writes only the counter.
te_tax_gen_count_goods_drift = {
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_automobiles = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_automobiles = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_clippers = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:clippers } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_clippers = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:clippers } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_clothes = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:clothes } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_clothes = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:clothes } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_coal = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:coal } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_coal = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:coal } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_coffee = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:coffee } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_coffee = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:coffee } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:consumer_appliances } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:consumer_appliances } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { var:te_tax_en_g_digital_access = 1 NOT = { has_consumption_tax = g:digital_access } } AND = { NOT = { var:te_tax_en_g_digital_access = 1 } has_consumption_tax = g:digital_access } } } change_variable = { name = te_tax_drift_goods add = 1 } }

# Wage tax: executes the enacted value's sunset once its month has come
# (rule 2). It runs only when the value has been operative since an earlier month,
# so a package's own sunset can never share its commencement call; otherwise it
# waits for next month. A late sunset catches up. One without a successor is
# dropped, not deferred, so it cannot hold te_tax_next_month in the past.
te_tax_gen_sunset_wage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp <= var:te_tax_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage_succ < 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = -1 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX sunset_dropped wage: no successor recorded; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage_since < var:te_tax_now }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = var:te_tax_now }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = -1 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
			change_variable = { name = te_tax_code_version add = 1 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 2 SLOT = none INST = 1 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX sunset wage; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "TE_TAX sunset_deferred wage: operative only since this month; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
	}
}

# Slot a: commences in its due month and in no other (rule 3). The processor runs
# on the 1st, so the package takes effect from the 1st. If a provision it touches was
# changed outside legislation since approval (te_tax_xver_*), the whole package holds
# and collections stay as they are. A due month already past holds it as missed. The
# obligations bound to it start with it (te_tax_obl_start), and wait while it is held.
te_tax_gen_commence_a = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_due = var:te_tax_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { te_tax_gen_package_current_a = yes }
			te_tax_gen_apply_a = yes
			change_variable = { name = te_tax_code_version add = 1 }
			# The obligations bound to this package start their clocks this month (plan Task 12).
			te_tax_obl_start = { SLOT = a }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_on value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 0 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 1 SLOT = a INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX commenced slot=a; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 2 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 3 SLOT = a INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX held_conflict slot=a: a touched provision changed outside legislation; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
	}
	else = {
		te_tax_gen_hold_missed_a = yes
	}
}

# Slot a: an awaiting package whose due month has passed holds as missed; it never
# commences late (spec: missed dates need explicit rescheduling). The watchdog calls
# this too, because it fires only once the month has passed.
te_tax_gen_hold_missed_a = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_now
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 3 }
		te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 4 SLOT = a INST = 0 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX held_missed slot=a: due month passed without commencement; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# Slot a: copies every field the package touches into the enacted code. Only
# te_tax_gen_commence_<slot> calls it, inside the processor, which has set te_tax_now,
# run this month's sunsets first and syncs collection once after every slot.
# Supersession of the enacted provision happens here, at commencement, never at
# approval: the package replaces the value and its sunset. With no sunset of its own
# the change is permanent and clears any pending sunset (_exp and _succ = -1). With
# one, the provision reverts to the underlying permanent rate: a sunset still pending
# now (this month's have run, so it is in the future) keeps its successor; otherwise
# the rate in force is the successor. Both are captured before anything is
# overwritten. The stored te_tax_p<slot>_<key>_succ is only the review's preview and
# is never read here.
te_tax_gen_apply_a = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_wage_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_wage_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = var:te_tax_pa_wage }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_div_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_div_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = var:te_tax_pa_div }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_div_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_land >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_land_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_land_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_land_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = var:te_tax_pa_land }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_land_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_head >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_head_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_head_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_head_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = var:te_tax_pa_head }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_head_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_cons >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pa_cons_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_cons_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_cons_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = var:te_tax_pa_cons }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_exp value = var:te_tax_pa_cons_exp }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_automobiles >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pa_g_automobiles } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_clippers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = var:te_tax_pa_g_clippers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clothes value = var:te_tax_pa_g_clothes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_coal >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = var:te_tax_pa_g_coal } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_coffee >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coffee value = var:te_tax_pa_g_coffee } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances value = var:te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_access >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_access } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = var:te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_electricity >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = var:te_tax_pa_g_electricity } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fabric >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fabric } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fine_art >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fine_art value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fine_art } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fish >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fish value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fish } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_fruit >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fruit value = var:te_tax_pa_g_fruit } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_furniture value = var:te_tax_pa_g_furniture } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_glass >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_glass value = var:te_tax_pa_g_glass } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_grain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_grain value = var:te_tax_pa_g_grain } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_groceries >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_groceries value = var:te_tax_pa_g_groceries } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_liquor >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_liquor value = var:te_tax_pa_g_liquor } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_clothes value = var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_clothes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_furniture value = var:te_tax_pa_g_luxury_furniture } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_meat >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_meat value = var:te_tax_pa_g_meat } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_oil >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_oil value = var:te_tax_pa_g_oil } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_opium >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_opium value = var:te_tax_pa_g_opium } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_paper >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_paper value = var:te_tax_pa_g_paper } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_porcelain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_porcelain value = var:te_tax_pa_g_porcelain } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_radios >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_radios value = var:te_tax_pa_g_radios } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_services >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_services value = var:te_tax_pa_g_services } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_silk >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_silk value = var:te_tax_pa_g_silk } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_small_arms >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pa_g_small_arms } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_steamers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_steamers value = var:te_tax_pa_g_steamers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_sugar >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_sugar value = var:te_tax_pa_g_sugar } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_tea >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tea value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tea } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_telephones >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_telephones value = var:te_tax_pa_g_telephones } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_tobacco >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tobacco } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = var:te_tax_pa_g_tourism } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_transportation >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = var:te_tax_pa_g_transportation } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_wine >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = var:te_tax_pa_g_wine } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_g_wood >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = var:te_tax_pa_g_wood } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_agrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_agrel value = var:te_tax_pa_agrel } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pa_regrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_regrel value = var:te_tax_pa_regrel } }
	# A package that restates regional relief names its whole state set, its own list
	# te_tax_pa_relief_states: it replaces the enacted list te_tax_en_relief_states (the canonical set,
	# at most three) with the states in it that this code keeps (te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept:
	# its own, or its civil-war counterpart's while a war lasts). The state marks
	# (te_tax_relief_state) follow from the list in the writer's relief sync
	# (te_tax_rebuild_relief_marks), which the processor runs after this month's
	# commencements. The slot's list is consumed either way.
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set = 1 }
		save_scope_as = te_tax_country
		if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_pa_relief_states
				limit = { te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept = yes }
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_en_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
}

# Slot a: writes an approved package from the bill record (te_tax_bl_*). Called
# only through te_tax_store_package, after te_tax_can_store_package and with
# scope:te_tax_country saved. Every payload field is written, so nothing stale from an
# earlier package survives. A sunset is due + offset, written only for an offset of at
# least one month. _succ is a preview for the review only (commencement decides the
# successor then, by te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>'s rule): the underlying permanent rate,
# from the other slot's awaiting package if it touches the provision earlier, else
# from the enacted provision. seq = one above both slots. The slot is switched on last.
# _due0 keeps the approved month and _pver_<group> the planned versions after this
# approval, for te_tax_cmd_package_reschedule: a missed package may move only a few
# months, and only while no later approval has touched what it changes.
te_tax_gen_store_a = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_due value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_due0 value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_seq > var:te_tax_pa_seq }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_seq value = var:te_tax_pb_seq }
	}
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_seq add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_wage }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_wage }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_wage_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_wage }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_wage_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_wage_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div value = var:te_tax_bl_div }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_div value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_div }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_div_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_div_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_div_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_div_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_div }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_div_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_div_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_div_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land value = var:te_tax_bl_land }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_land value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_land }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_land_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_land_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_land_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_land_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_land >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_land }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_land_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_land_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_land_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_land_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head value = var:te_tax_bl_head }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_head value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_head }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_head_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_head_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_head_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_head_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_head >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_head }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_head_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_head_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_head_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_head_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons value = var:te_tax_bl_cons }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_cons value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_cons }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_cons_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_cons_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pb_cons >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_cons }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pb_cons_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pb_cons_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_pb_cons_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_cons_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_automobiles value = var:te_tax_bl_g_automobiles }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_clippers value = var:te_tax_bl_g_clippers }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_clothes value = var:te_tax_bl_g_clothes }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_coal value = var:te_tax_bl_g_coal }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_coffee value = var:te_tax_bl_g_coffee }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_consumer_appliances value = var:te_tax_bl_g_consumer_appliances }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_digital_access value = var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_access }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_digital_assets value = var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_assets }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_electricity value = var:te_tax_bl_g_electricity }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fabric value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fabric }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fine_art value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fine_art }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fish value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fish }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_fruit value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fruit }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_furniture value = var:te_tax_bl_g_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_glass value = var:te_tax_bl_g_glass }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_grain value = var:te_tax_bl_g_grain }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_groceries value = var:te_tax_bl_g_groceries }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_liquor value = var:te_tax_bl_g_liquor }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_luxury_clothes value = var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_clothes }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_luxury_furniture value = var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_meat value = var:te_tax_bl_g_meat }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_oil value = var:te_tax_bl_g_oil }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_opium value = var:te_tax_bl_g_opium }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_paper value = var:te_tax_bl_g_paper }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_porcelain value = var:te_tax_bl_g_porcelain }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_radios value = var:te_tax_bl_g_radios }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_services value = var:te_tax_bl_g_services }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_silk value = var:te_tax_bl_g_silk }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_small_arms value = var:te_tax_bl_g_small_arms }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_steamers value = var:te_tax_bl_g_steamers }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_sugar value = var:te_tax_bl_g_sugar }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_tea value = var:te_tax_bl_g_tea }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_telephones value = var:te_tax_bl_g_telephones }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_tobacco value = var:te_tax_bl_g_tobacco }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_tourism value = var:te_tax_bl_g_tourism }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_transportation value = var:te_tax_bl_g_transportation }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_wine value = var:te_tax_bl_g_wine }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_g_wood value = var:te_tax_bl_g_wood }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_goods value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_goods }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_wage value = var:te_tax_pver_wage }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_div value = var:te_tax_pver_div }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_land value = var:te_tax_pver_land }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_head value = var:te_tax_pver_head }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_cons value = var:te_tax_pver_cons }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_goods value = var:te_tax_pver_goods }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_pver_relief value = var:te_tax_pver_relief }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_agrel value = var:te_tax_bl_agrel }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel value = var:te_tax_bl_regrel }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_xver_relief value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_relief }
	# Regional relief: a bill that touches it (te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0) names its whole
	# state set in te_tax_bl_relief_states, possibly none, copied into the slot's te_tax_pa_relief_states;
	# commencement replaces the enacted list with it.
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pa_relief_states }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_bl_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_bl_relief_states
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_pa_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_regrel_states_set value = 0 }
	}
	debug_log = "TE_TAX stored slot=a; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_state value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pa_on value = 1 }
}

# Slot b: commences in its due month and in no other (rule 3). The processor runs
# on the 1st, so the package takes effect from the 1st. If a provision it touches was
# changed outside legislation since approval (te_tax_xver_*), the whole package holds
# and collections stay as they are. A due month already past holds it as missed. The
# obligations bound to it start with it (te_tax_obl_start), and wait while it is held.
te_tax_gen_commence_b = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_due = var:te_tax_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { te_tax_gen_package_current_b = yes }
			te_tax_gen_apply_b = yes
			change_variable = { name = te_tax_code_version add = 1 }
			# The obligations bound to this package start their clocks this month (plan Task 12).
			te_tax_obl_start = { SLOT = b }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_on value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 0 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 1 SLOT = b INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX commenced slot=b; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 2 }
			te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 3 SLOT = b INST = 0 }
			debug_log = "TE_TAX held_conflict slot=b: a touched provision changed outside legislation; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
		}
	}
	else = {
		te_tax_gen_hold_missed_b = yes
	}
}

# Slot b: an awaiting package whose due month has passed holds as missed; it never
# commences late (spec: missed dates need explicit rescheduling). The watchdog calls
# this too, because it fires only once the month has passed.
te_tax_gen_hold_missed_b = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_now
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 3 }
		te_tax_gen_history_write = { KIND = 4 SLOT = b INST = 0 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX held_missed slot=b: due month passed without commencement; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# Slot b: copies every field the package touches into the enacted code. Only
# te_tax_gen_commence_<slot> calls it, inside the processor, which has set te_tax_now,
# run this month's sunsets first and syncs collection once after every slot.
# Supersession of the enacted provision happens here, at commencement, never at
# approval: the package replaces the value and its sunset. With no sunset of its own
# the change is permanent and clears any pending sunset (_exp and _succ = -1). With
# one, the provision reverts to the underlying permanent rate: a sunset still pending
# now (this month's have run, so it is in the future) keeps its successor; otherwise
# the rate in force is the successor. Both are captured before anything is
# overwritten. The stored te_tax_p<slot>_<key>_succ is only the review's preview and
# is never read here.
te_tax_gen_apply_b = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_wage >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_wage_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_wage_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = var:te_tax_pb_wage }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_wage_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_div >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_div_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_div_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_div_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = var:te_tax_pb_div }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_div_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_land >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_land_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_land_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_land_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = var:te_tax_pb_land }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_land_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_head >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_head_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_head_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_head_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = var:te_tax_pb_head }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_head_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_cons >= 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_tax_pb_cons_exp >= 0 }
			# A pending sunset with a successor keeps it; otherwise the rate in force.
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:te_tax_en_cons_exp < 0
						var:te_tax_en_cons_succ < 0
					}
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = -1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = var:te_tax_pb_cons }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = var:te_tax_now }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_exp value = var:te_tax_pb_cons_exp }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_automobiles >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = var:te_tax_pb_g_automobiles } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_clippers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = var:te_tax_pb_g_clippers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clothes value = var:te_tax_pb_g_clothes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_coal >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = var:te_tax_pb_g_coal } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_coffee >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coffee value = var:te_tax_pb_g_coffee } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_consumer_appliances >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances value = var:te_tax_pb_g_consumer_appliances } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_access >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_access } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_assets >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = var:te_tax_pb_g_digital_assets } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_electricity >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = var:te_tax_pb_g_electricity } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_fabric >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = var:te_tax_pb_g_fabric } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_fine_art >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fine_art value = var:te_tax_pb_g_fine_art } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_fish >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fish value = var:te_tax_pb_g_fish } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_fruit >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fruit value = var:te_tax_pb_g_fruit } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_furniture value = var:te_tax_pb_g_furniture } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_glass >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_glass value = var:te_tax_pb_g_glass } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_grain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_grain value = var:te_tax_pb_g_grain } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_groceries >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_groceries value = var:te_tax_pb_g_groceries } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_liquor >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_liquor value = var:te_tax_pb_g_liquor } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_luxury_clothes >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_clothes value = var:te_tax_pb_g_luxury_clothes } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_luxury_furniture >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_furniture value = var:te_tax_pb_g_luxury_furniture } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_meat >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_meat value = var:te_tax_pb_g_meat } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_oil >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_oil value = var:te_tax_pb_g_oil } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_opium >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_opium value = var:te_tax_pb_g_opium } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_paper >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_paper value = var:te_tax_pb_g_paper } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_porcelain >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_porcelain value = var:te_tax_pb_g_porcelain } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_radios >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_radios value = var:te_tax_pb_g_radios } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_services >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_services value = var:te_tax_pb_g_services } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_silk >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_silk value = var:te_tax_pb_g_silk } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_small_arms >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_small_arms value = var:te_tax_pb_g_small_arms } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_steamers >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_steamers value = var:te_tax_pb_g_steamers } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_sugar >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_sugar value = var:te_tax_pb_g_sugar } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_tea >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tea value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tea } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_telephones >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_telephones value = var:te_tax_pb_g_telephones } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_tobacco >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tobacco value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tobacco } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = var:te_tax_pb_g_tourism } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_transportation >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = var:te_tax_pb_g_transportation } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_wine >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = var:te_tax_pb_g_wine } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_g_wood >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = var:te_tax_pb_g_wood } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_agrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_agrel value = var:te_tax_pb_agrel } }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_pb_regrel >= 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_regrel value = var:te_tax_pb_regrel } }
	# A package that restates regional relief names its whole state set, its own list
	# te_tax_pb_relief_states: it replaces the enacted list te_tax_en_relief_states (the canonical set,
	# at most three) with the states in it that this code keeps (te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept:
	# its own, or its civil-war counterpart's while a war lasts). The state marks
	# (te_tax_relief_state) follow from the list in the writer's relief sync
	# (te_tax_rebuild_relief_marks), which the processor runs after this month's
	# commencements. The slot's list is consumed either way.
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pb_regrel_states_set = 1 }
		save_scope_as = te_tax_country
		if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_en_relief_states }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_pb_relief_states
				limit = { te_tax_relief_listed_state_kept = yes }
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_en_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
}

# Slot b: writes an approved package from the bill record (te_tax_bl_*). Called
# only through te_tax_store_package, after te_tax_can_store_package and with
# scope:te_tax_country saved. Every payload field is written, so nothing stale from an
# earlier package survives. A sunset is due + offset, written only for an offset of at
# least one month. _succ is a preview for the review only (commencement decides the
# successor then, by te_tax_gen_apply_<slot>'s rule): the underlying permanent rate,
# from the other slot's awaiting package if it touches the provision earlier, else
# from the enacted provision. seq = one above both slots. The slot is switched on last.
# _due0 keeps the approved month and _pver_<group> the planned versions after this
# approval, for te_tax_cmd_package_reschedule: a missed package may move only a few
# months, and only while no later approval has touched what it changes.
te_tax_gen_store_b = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_due value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_due0 value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_pa_seq > var:te_tax_pb_seq }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_seq value = var:te_tax_pa_seq }
	}
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_seq add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_wage }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_wage value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_wage }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_wage >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_wage_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_wage_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_en_wage_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_wage >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_wage }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_wage_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_wage_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_wage_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div value = var:te_tax_bl_div }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_div value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_div }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_div >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_div_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_div_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_div_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_div_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = var:te_tax_en_div_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_div >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_div }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_div_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_div_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_div_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_div_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land value = var:te_tax_bl_land }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_land value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_land }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_land >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_land_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_land_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_land_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_land_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_succ value = var:te_tax_en_land_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_land >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_land }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_land_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_land_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_land_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_land_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head value = var:te_tax_bl_head }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_head value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_head }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_head >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_head_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_head_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_head_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_head_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_succ value = var:te_tax_en_head_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_head >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_head }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_head_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_head_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_head_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_head_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons value = var:te_tax_bl_cons }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_cons value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_cons }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_bl_cons >= 0
			var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun >= 1
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_exp value = var:te_tax_bl_due }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_exp add = var:te_tax_bl_cons_sun }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_en_cons_exp >= 0
				var:te_tax_en_cons_succ >= 0
			}
			set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_en_cons_succ }
		}
		# The other slot's payload exists only while it is on, so read it nested.
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_bl_due
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:te_tax_pa_cons >= 0 }
				set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_cons }
				if = {
					limit = {
						var:te_tax_pa_cons_exp >= 0
						var:te_tax_pa_cons_succ >= 0
					}
					set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_succ value = var:te_tax_pa_cons_succ }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_exp value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_cons_succ value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_aeroplanes value = var:te_tax_bl_g_aeroplanes }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_automobiles value = var:te_tax_bl_g_automobiles }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_clippers value = var:te_tax_bl_g_clippers }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_clothes value = var:te_tax_bl_g_clothes }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_coal value = var:te_tax_bl_g_coal }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_coffee value = var:te_tax_bl_g_coffee }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_consumer_appliances value = var:te_tax_bl_g_consumer_appliances }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_digital_access value = var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_access }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_digital_assets value = var:te_tax_bl_g_digital_assets }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_electricity value = var:te_tax_bl_g_electricity }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_fabric value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fabric }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_fine_art value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fine_art }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_fish value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fish }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_fruit value = var:te_tax_bl_g_fruit }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_furniture value = var:te_tax_bl_g_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_glass value = var:te_tax_bl_g_glass }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_grain value = var:te_tax_bl_g_grain }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_groceries value = var:te_tax_bl_g_groceries }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_liquor value = var:te_tax_bl_g_liquor }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_luxury_clothes value = var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_clothes }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_luxury_furniture value = var:te_tax_bl_g_luxury_furniture }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_meat value = var:te_tax_bl_g_meat }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_oil value = var:te_tax_bl_g_oil }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_opium value = var:te_tax_bl_g_opium }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_paper value = var:te_tax_bl_g_paper }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_porcelain value = var:te_tax_bl_g_porcelain }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_radios value = var:te_tax_bl_g_radios }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_services value = var:te_tax_bl_g_services }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_silk value = var:te_tax_bl_g_silk }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_small_arms value = var:te_tax_bl_g_small_arms }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_steamers value = var:te_tax_bl_g_steamers }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_sugar value = var:te_tax_bl_g_sugar }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_tea value = var:te_tax_bl_g_tea }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_telephones value = var:te_tax_bl_g_telephones }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_tobacco value = var:te_tax_bl_g_tobacco }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_tourism value = var:te_tax_bl_g_tourism }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_transportation value = var:te_tax_bl_g_transportation }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_wine value = var:te_tax_bl_g_wine }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_g_wood value = var:te_tax_bl_g_wood }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_goods value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_goods }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_wage value = var:te_tax_pver_wage }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_div value = var:te_tax_pver_div }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_land value = var:te_tax_pver_land }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_head value = var:te_tax_pver_head }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_cons value = var:te_tax_pver_cons }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_goods value = var:te_tax_pver_goods }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_pver_relief value = var:te_tax_pver_relief }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_agrel value = var:te_tax_bl_agrel }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_regrel value = var:te_tax_bl_regrel }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_xver_relief value = var:te_tax_bl_xver_relief }
	# Regional relief: a bill that touches it (te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0) names its whole
	# state set in te_tax_bl_relief_states, possibly none, copied into the slot's te_tax_pb_relief_states;
	# commencement replaces the enacted list with it.
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states } clear_variable_list = te_tax_pb_relief_states }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_bl_regrel >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_regrel_states_set value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = te_tax_bl_relief_states }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = te_tax_bl_relief_states
				scope:te_tax_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = te_tax_pb_relief_states target = PREV } }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_regrel_states_set value = 0 }
	}
	debug_log = "TE_TAX stored slot=b; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_state value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_pb_on value = 1 }
}

# te_tax_next_month: the earliest month with a transition due, -1 if none. Enacted
# sunsets and awaiting packages count; a held package waits for rescheduling and does
# not. A deferred sunset keeps it at the current month until it runs.
te_tax_gen_next_month = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_wage_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_wage_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_wage_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_div_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_div_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_div_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_land_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_land_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_land_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_head_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_head_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_head_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_en_cons_exp >= 0
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_en_cons_exp < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_en_cons_exp }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pa_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pa_state = 1
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_pa_due < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_pa_due }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_pb_on = 1
			var:te_tax_pb_state = 1
			OR = {
				var:te_tax_next_month < 0
				var:te_tax_pb_due < var:te_tax_next_month
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_next_month value = var:te_tax_pb_due }
	}
}

# The history ring: 8 entries te_tax_h<n>_*, te_tax_h_head pointing at the newest
# (0 = empty). Advances the head, then overwrites that entry. KIND: the schema doc's
# history kinds; SLOT: none, a or b (stored as te_tax_slot_id_<SLOT>); INST: 1..5 for
# the instrument a sunset executed (INSTRUMENTS order), else 0. Public entry point:
# te_tax_history_push = { KIND SLOT }.
te_tax_gen_history_write = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:te_tax_h_head >= 1
			var:te_tax_h_head < 8
		}
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_h_head add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h_head value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h1_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h2_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h3_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h4_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h5_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h6_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h7_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_h_head = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_month value = te_history_month_index }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_kind value = $KIND$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_slot value = te_tax_slot_id_$SLOT$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_inst value = $INST$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_h8_version value = var:te_tax_code_version }
	}
}

# Migration, rates: the enacted indices that reproduce the active vanilla taxation law at
# the country's native tax level, one branch per (law, level) pair (MIGRATION in the
# generator). Every branch writes all five indices. A country already on the carrier
# without tokens (a rebel or a released country that inherited it), or on any other law
# (the probe carrier, another mod's law), migrates as all zeros and is flagged.
# Called only by te_tax_migrate_country.
te_tax_gen_migrate_rates = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_consumption_based_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 16 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 22 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 28 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 34 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_land_based_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 40 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }

		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 11 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 14 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 14 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_per_capita_based_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }

		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 17 }

	}
	else_if = {

	}

	else_if = {

	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_proportional_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = very_low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = low }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = medium }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 7 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_graduated_taxation tax_level = very_high }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_law = law_type:law_te_tax_code }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_migration_discrepancy value = 1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX migration_discrepancy holds law_te_tax_code without migration tokens; every rate migrated as 0; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_migration_discrepancy value = 1 }
		debug_log = "TE_TAX migration_discrepancy no mapping for the active taxation law; every rate migrated as 0; month=[SCOPE.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0] date=[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString] country=[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}
}

# Migration, goods: a catalog good is on the enacted list exactly when the country taxes
# it natively. A good outside the catalog is not carried; the first sync removes it.
te_tax_gen_migrate_goods = {
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:aeroplanes } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_aeroplanes value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:automobiles } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_automobiles value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:clippers } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clippers value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:clothes } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clothes value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_clothes value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:coal } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coal value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:coffee } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coffee value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_coffee value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:consumer_appliances } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_consumer_appliances value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:digital_access } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_access value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:digital_assets } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_digital_assets value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:electricity } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_electricity value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:fabric } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fabric value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:fine_art } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fine_art value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fine_art value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:fish } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fish value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fish value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:fruit } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fruit value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_fruit value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:furniture } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_furniture value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_furniture value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:glass } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_glass value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_glass value = 0 } }

	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:groceries } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_groceries value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_groceries value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:liquor } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_liquor value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_liquor value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:luxury_clothes } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_clothes value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_clothes value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:luxury_furniture } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_luxury_furniture value = 1 } }

	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_oil value = 0 } }
