	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_opium value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:paper } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_paper value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_paper value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:porcelain } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_porcelain value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_porcelain value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:radios } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_radios value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_radios value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:services } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_services value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_services value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:silk } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_silk value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_silk value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:small_arms } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_small_arms value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_small_arms value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:steamers } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_steamers value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_steamers value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:sugar } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_sugar value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_sugar value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tea } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tea value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tea value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:telephones } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_telephones value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_telephones value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tobacco } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tobacco value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tobacco value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:tourism } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_tourism value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:transportation } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_transportation value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:wine } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wine value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_consumption_tax = g:wood } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_g_wood value = 0 } }
	# A migration is a change made outside legislation.
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_goods add = 1 }
}

# Migration, provisions: a collected instrument is operative from this month; none has
# a sunset or a successor. A migration is a change made outside legislation, so each
# instrument's external-change token moves.
te_tax_gen_migrate_provisions = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_wage add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_div > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_div add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_land > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_land add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_head > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_head add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = te_history_month_index }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_since value = -1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_exp value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons_succ value = -1 }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_xver_cons add = 1 }
}

# Interest-group views of the enacted code (te_tax_refresh_ig_views, from the monthly
# processor only): each group's band (te_tax_ig_band_<ig>: its stance toward the vanilla
# taxation law the code is equivalent to, -2..2) keeps at most one te_tax_ig_view_<ig>_<band>
# on the country, and none at band 0. A band's modifier is added only where it is missing and
# the others are removed only where present, so an unchanged band changes nothing. Modifier
# changes are not visible later in the same effect; nothing here reads one back.
te_tax_gen_ig_views = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_armed_forces }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m2 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_m1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_armed_forces_p2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_band value = te_tax_ig_band_devout }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m2 } }

	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = -1 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m1 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_m1 } }

	if = { limit = { NOT = { local_var:te_tax_band = 1 } has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p1 } remove_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p1 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_band = 2 NOT = { has_modifier = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p2 } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_ig_view_devout_p2 } }

# Outbreak copy of the policy obligations (plan Task 12): the payload of every slot whose
# obligation binds the original (te_tax_obl_binding: bound to a passed bill, delivering or
# maintaining), with its clocks, so it binds the rebels on the same terms (spec 10: binding
# obligations follow the copied code). A pending one belongs to the bill, which stays with
# the government that wrote it: te_tax_copy_code releases it on the rebels afterwards.
te_tax_gen_copy_obligations = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { te_tax_obl_binding = { N = 1 } } }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_kind }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_arg }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_target }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_baseline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_ig }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_deadline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_maint_end }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_streak }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_fails }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_maint_only }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_slot }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o1_rev }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { te_tax_obl_binding = { N = 2 } } }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_kind }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_arg }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_target }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_baseline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_ig }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_deadline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_maint_end }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_streak }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_fails }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_maint_only }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_slot }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o2_rev }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { te_tax_obl_binding = { N = 3 } } }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_kind }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_arg }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_target }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_baseline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_ig }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_deadline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_maint_end }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_streak }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_fails }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_maint_only }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_slot }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o3_rev }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:te_tax_source = { te_tax_obl_binding = { N = 4 } } }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_kind }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_arg }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_target }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_baseline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_ig }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_deadline }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_maint_end }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_streak }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_fails }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_maint_only }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_slot }
		te_tax_copy_token = { NAME = te_tax_o4_rev }
	}

# A released country starts with no obligation and no record of kept or broken promises
# (te_tax_init_released_country; a revived tag may carry them from an earlier life). The
# parent's obligations stay with the parent.
te_tax_gen_clear_obligations = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o1_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o1_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o2_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o2_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o3_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o3_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o4_on value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_o4_state value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_armed_forces_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_devout_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_industrialists_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_intelligentsia_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_landowners_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_petty_bourgeoisie_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_rural_folk_month value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_trust_trade_unions_month value = -1 }
}
